title: The paid-run estimate misses new eval cases
what: bin/paid-cost estimates a paid run per case (each case's stored cost, a new case at the mean case cost), so a suite that grew is estimated at its new size.
why: 26 Oct: the estimate said mean $8.27 over 16 stored runs; the run cost $17.43: the 15 old cases cost $8.24, 12 new cases added $9.35. The estimate averages whole batches and misses suite growth.
failing_case: bin/paid-cost estimate on 26 Oct printed "mean $8.27" for a run that cost $17.43.
pass_cases: With the 26 Oct records, the estimate for the current suite is within 15% of $17.43.
where: bin/paid-cost estimate: the mean over whole stored runs
